_note: One concept can become a ladder of help. Each container has a purpose and a boundary; the video is the front door, not the final product.

ladder.purpose: Interrupt automatic perception with one honest mechanism and one invitation.
ladder.boundary: Do not compress uncertainty into a viral certainty.

ladder.purpose: Explain evidence, alternatives and limits in enough space to preserve nuance.
Let the person gather their own observation rather than borrow ours.
ladder.boundary: The test must not pretend to prove more than it can observe.

ladder.purpose: Help separate observation, interpretation, prediction and inherited belief.
ladder.boundary: No diagnosis and no required emotional outcome.

ladder.purpose: Move the lens into relationships through checking instead of mind-reading.
ladder.boundary: Do not use the framework to invalidate another person's account.

ladder.purpose: Return attention to the body and ordinary environment.
ladder.boundary: Non-clinical; never framed as treatment or a substitute for care.

ladder.purpose: Make belief analysis a shared practice that permits disagreement.
ladder.boundary: Moderate certainty contests, guru dynamics and pressure to disclose.

ladder.purpose: Teach evidence, inference, cognitive difference and model revision.
ladder.boundary: Present multiple interpretations and age-appropriate grounding.

help_domains.emotional_literacy: Notice body signals, predictions and labels without invalidating emotion.
help_domains.relationship_repair: Separate observed behavior from the model built around it.
help_domains.belief_auditing: Examine origin, evidence, cost, alternatives and revision conditions.
help_domains.media_literacy: See how separate facts, images and memories are edited into a seamless story.
help_domains.decision_review: Distinguish the decision process from the explanation invented afterward.
help_domains.identity_flexibility: Treat identity as useful organization without turning it into a permanent sentence.
help_domains.grounded_wonder: Restore astonishment while keeping contact with the ordinary.
help_domains.agency_practice: Replace total control fantasies with one proportionate act.
